pictures.name: hillside_of_blossom_at_sunrise
pictures.scene: a whole hillside covered in open blossom taking the first sun of the morning, the nearest flowering branches lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the slope and pale sky above them soft and dim

pictures.name: noon_light_filling_a_bare_room
pictures.scene: a wide band of clear noon light lying right across the floor of a bare stone room, the lit floor warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the plain walls above it dim and quiet and altogether empty

pictures.name: high_lookout_over_the_whole_plain
pictures.scene: a bare rock outcrop looking out over an enormous plain that runs away for miles, the near stone lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the far country and sky above it pale and open and still

pictures.name: spring_running_beside_the_track
pictures.scene: a small spring running steadily along the whole length of a track and keeping close beside it, the water lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the way and the country above it soft and dim

pictures.name: young_tree_taller_than_the_old_wall
pictures.scene: a young tree in strong leaf grown well up past the top of an old low wall beside it, the trunk and wall lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the branches above them soft and dark and quiet

pictures.name: deep_well_with_light_on_the_water
pictures.scene: a deep round well with clear light resting far down on the still water at its foot, the wellhead lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the dark shaft above and behind it cool and quiet

pictures.name: clear_air_after_rain_over_a_far_range
pictures.scene: air washed so clear after rain that a distant mountain range stands out sharp and complete, the near wet grass lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the ranges and sky above them pale and cool

pictures.name: gate_latch_dropped_firmly_home
pictures.scene: a heavy timber latch dropped fully home into its keeper on a field gate, the latch and the nearest bar lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the gate and the pasture beyond it dim and quiet

pictures.name: stepping_stones_crossing_clean_water
pictures.scene: a line of flat stepping stones set across a shallow stream of very clean water, the nearest stones lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the water and far bank above them soft and dim and calm

pictures.name: sapling_tied_to_a_straight_stake
pictures.scene: a young sapling bound along a straight wooden stake so that it grows dead true, the tie and the base of the stake lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the stem and leaves above them soft and dim

pictures.name: honey_pouring_from_a_jar
pictures.scene: thick golden honey pouring in a slow rope from a tilted clay jar onto a wooden board, the honey lit warm and brilliant at the bottom of the frame, the jar and the wall above it brown and dim and still

pictures.name: clear_way_with_thorn_scrub_beyond
pictures.scene: one clear open track running ahead with rough thorn scrub crowding the ground on either side of it, the near way lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the scrub and sky above it dull and dim

lines.text: Oh, how I love Your law!
All day long it is my meditation.
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies,
for they are always with me.
I have more insight than all my teachers,
for Your testimonies are my meditation.
I discern more than the elders,
I have kept my feet from every evil path,
that I may keep Your word.
I have not departed from Your ordinances,
for You Yourself have taught me.
How sweet are Your words to my taste—
sweeter than honey in my mouth!
I gain understanding from Your precepts;
therefore I hate every false way.
